title: Grip It Like You Mean It (Chas McIvor)
style: foghorn leghorn rooster strut, country swing, bluegrass banjo, brass, bongo, fast beat 132 bpm, comedy dad voice, spoken interjections
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken-strut]
I say, I say, son — pay attention now!
C for cat, h for ha, a for apple, s for stupid — Chas!
Now grab that club like ya mean it, boy!

[Verse 1]
Ten fingers on the leather, son, that's the overlap way
Left hand crowns the handle, right hand comes to play
Pinky of the right rides the index of the left
Grip pressure four out of ten, don't squeeze the life out yet

[Pre-Chorus]
Not too tight, not too loose
Like ya holdin' a baby chicken, son — don't ya cook the goose!

[Chorus]
Grip it like ya mean it, swing it like ya breathe
V's pointin' to the shoulder, that's the line ya weave
Four outta ten, son, four outta ten
Let the club do the work and ya swing again

[Verse 2]
Thumb pad down the shaft, a quarter inch from the top
Knuckles two and a half showin', that's where the good shots drop
Weak grip slice it sideways, strong grip hooks it home
Neutral's where ya livin' if ya wanna own the zone

[Bridge - Chas dad-joke]
I say, son — why'd the golfer bring two pairs of pants?
In case he got a hole in one! Ha! Now hush and grip the dance!

[Chorus]
Grip it like ya mean it, swing it like ya breathe
V's pointin' to the shoulder, that's the line ya weave
Four outta ten, son, four outta ten
Let the club do the work and ya swing again

[Outro]
That's my boy. That's my boy.
Grip pressure four. Walk it back. Do it again.
